evidenceKind: primary-source schema review and generated ASCII/Binary regression
scope: LWPOLYLINE repeated per-vertex field association under group-code reordering
Declared vertex count and existing resource cap
Following-entity framing and callback refusal for excess fields

sources.revision: Published 2024 LWPOLYLINE entity reference and general entity-code guidance

observations.coordinateArrays: Repeated group 10 values are OCS X coordinates and repeated group 20 values are OCS Y coordinates, one entry per vertex.
observations.optionalArrays: Groups 40/41/42/91 represent per-vertex start width, end width, bulge, and identifier values; omitted widths/bulges use defaults.
observations.ordering: General entity-code guidance prohibits assuming displayed group-code order; preserve each repeated-code occurrence order to retain vertex ordinal.

sources.limitation: The schema establishes DXF field association, not DWG byte layouts, rendering, or downstream CAD acceptance.

localAudit.reproducedFailure: The old parser created each vertex only on group 10 and updated the last-created vertex for groups 20/40/41/42/91. Generated grouped-by-code ASCII and Binary input lost or misbound values.
localAudit.correction: Independent occurrence counters map groups 10/20/40/41/42/91 to their per-vertex ordinal. Every array is bounded by the existing one-million vertex cap and, once known, group 90. The X count must match the materialized vertex count; omitted optional fields retain zero defaults.
localAudit.apiCompatibility: No public data field or virtual changed. Private parser counters change the installed class layout, so downstream binaries must rebuild against the updated header/library.
generatedCoverage: Three non-square vertices with distinct asymmetric coordinate values
Distinct start/end widths, bulges, and vertex identifiers
ASCII and Binary records reordered into per-field ordinal arrays
Exact comparison of all vertex and entity fields
Excess repeated Y rejected before the polyline callback
All files are temporary generated controls; no fixture added
